Simple forms and minimal backdrop, modest detail sufficient for a small card. No words, letters, digits, logos, watermark or card border. A small green fantasy goblin in a patched orange adventurer tunic and a crooked little helmet is ready for a quest, but his ridiculously oversized boots have their curled toes tangled together. He studies the knot in puzzled concentration, holding a tiny wooden practice sword, harmless clumsy slapstick.
